Notes_and_Tips: For hypertension and stress, keep salt moderate and avoid heavy late night meals.
Because late nights trigger eating, keep roasted makhana ready instead of sweets.
Make paneer or dal the main portion to improve physique and support fat loss.
Simple repetitive meals will help you stay consistent even with a busy software routine.
Try to maintain regular meal timing to improve energy and reduce anxiety.
